newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian CBR, others in waste energy JV.
newsitem.headline: Belgian CBR, others in waste energy JV.

text.p: Belgian cement company CBR said on Friday it had set up a joint venture with two other Belgian companies to acquire 74 percent of waste energy company Societe de Traitement de Produits Industriels SA (STPI).
STPI makes use of a patented process to produce resofuel, a sawdust-based substitute fuel used as a combustible in cement and other energy-hungry manufacturing processes, CBR said in a statement.
STPI produces around 140,000 tonnes of the fuel a year and has sales of around 550 million Belgian francs, it added.
CBR's partners in the joint venture, called Resofuel NV, are Watco, a unit of the Tractebel group, and Vulcain Industries, part of the Cockerill Sambre group.
The remaining 26 percent of shares in STPI will remain in the hands of Belgian individuals.
